---
description: Perform a production-oriented review of the current Java change.
agent: jse-tester
---

Review the current change for:
- correctness
- API design
- Java 21+ idioms
- concurrency
- exception handling
- resource management
- security
- test quality
- formatting
- Checkstyle
- PMD
- SpotBugs
- Maven reproducibility

Do not make production changes. Write findings to `.github/jse/work/TEST-REPORT.md`.
